oṃ namo mahābhairavāyaḥ oṃ nama kubjikāyai || namostute mahāśānaṃ svacchandaparameśvaraṃ || kubjikāśca samāyuktaṃ paramānandamaṃṇḍitaṃ || bhairava bhairavīproktaṃ paramatatvalayāgatā || dīkṣāsārottaraṃ sāraṃ narānāpāsacchedanaṃ || pañcamaṃ samayadīkṣā dvitiyaṃñca vasiṣṭhakaṃ || tṛtīyaṃ sarvvādhikāraṃ nirvvānaṃ bhedadīkṣayā mānuṣānā hitārthāya dīkṣākramānimuttamaṃ || saptajanmārjite pāpaṃ sacareti marāpahā || yāyuśrīkānti saubhāgyaṃ la (* *?) kṣmī puṣṭivivarddhanaṃ || aṣṭasvarai khacaratvaṃ tadīkṣāmātreṇa pāpahā ||

(5) kini (2) vicce krokanāyai śrīparāparavaktre pādukāṃ || madhye || (5) sūryamaṇḍalāya nama || (5) caṇḍamaṇḍalāya nama || (5) vahnimaṇḍalāya nama || (5) akhaṇḍamaṇḍalaya nama || candanākṣata puṣpaṃ siṃdhūra phala tāmbūla tandūla dhūpa dīpa naivedya alibalisahitaṃ sātmādana ityādi || supītā varadā bhavastu || stotra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāṃraṃ || vyāpatahyena carācaraṃ tapadaṃ dasyataṃ hyena tasmai śrīguruve nama || 1 || ajñāna timirādhasya jñānāñjanasalākayā || cakṣu urmmilita yena tasmai śrīguruve nama || 2 || jñānaśaktisamārūḍhaṃ tatvamālā vibhūṣitaṃ | bhuktimukti pradātāraṃ || guruvande yathāśivaṃ || 3 || gurubrahmā guruviṣṇu gurudevo maheśvara || gurudeva jaga sarvvaṃ tasmai śrīguruve nama || 4 || guro gurutaraṃ caiva ye cānnye gurubhrātaṃra |
gururāmāpraśādeṇa || guruvande yathāśivaṃ || 5 || mokṣamāgapradātāraṃ saṃśārapāśacchedani || ādimādimanādi ca śrīguru praṇamāmyahaṃ || 6 || karmma dhyāṇaṃ ca dharmaśca dikṣāmārggaprabodhaka || ajñāna gyānasabodhaṃ tasmai śrīgurudevatā || 7 || paramākṣara dātāraṃ saṃśāraḥ cchedapāraga || bhavedustaraṇaṃ dātā tasmai śrīguruve nama || 8 || tīrthadevatva mātṛtva guruḥ paramadevatā || ānadaṃ bhuvanaṃ rūpaṃ kṣamasva guruve nama || 9 || catuvaktraṃccaturvvāhu pītāgaṃ pīta vāsana | śākṣācchūtra ca pustañca namaste guru pādaya || 10 || gururājāya vai tubhya guro gurustadullabhaṃ || guru vācā praśādeṇa piṇḍasuddhi ca jāyate || 11 || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpa sarvvavyādhivivarjjitaṃ |

soḍhuna śakaumi jamamṛtyujarādikaṃ karmmanā manasā vāccā mayānmāviniveditaṃ || anugahaṃ tu mā siddhiḥ ye kecit māsanāvinā || ājñayādi pramānasya pamānaṃ vācayo yadi || yadyastu gurorājñā samukhī bhavatā mama || vinikṛtaṃ tu pāśaugha māmudharatu saṃkaṭhāṭh | tadiyograṃ saṃmenātha naivānya saraṇaṃ mama || tasmāt tvaṃ kṛpayā nātha dīkṣādāna ca dehi me | dīyate jñāna sabhāva kṣīyate karmmavāsanā || tena dīkṣāpramānañca dehi me kṛpayā mama ||

stotra || maṇḍarāya namastubhyaṃ sarvvatatvādhipāya ca bhūbhuva svapakāsāya maṇḍalāya namostute || kriyālopanakattavyaṃ mama kāryaṃ vasiddhiye || kṣamyaṃ guruvedenavaprasaṃṇaṃnesmin guruve nama ||
iti maṇḍalavisarjana || madalasaṣoṅa svānagvayugvāla dakṣiṇā guruviya || śubhe hariśunakṣatre suprasaṃneṣu cetasā || dātumarasi me nātha dīkṣādānaṃ taduttamaṃ | dadātumyahaṃ te putra supranena tetasā || gurocaraṇapasādā iśvarasya prasādatta || evamastu gṛhītvā || maṇḍalaṃ visarjjanaṃ || mahālamundrānadhvaya || madhyesa sindhalakāyāva ||
viyaguru || ātmavidyāśivatatvaṃ supranostu || sarvvapuṣpaṃ śiraśi pranāmaṃ || nirmmālya puṣpaṃ iśānaṃ saṃtaya nirmmālyapuṣpaṃ pūjayat || oṃ nirmmālya caṇḍānāya nama || hastapakṣālayat || [iti gurumaṇḍalapūjāvidhi] || thanā pāphakye || brahmahatyāju gamyakaṃ tilityahatyā catujuga devamatrapakāsyan | laulamaṃnalakaṃ vajye || nivarccaṇayāṅāva || sikhe svadhayat || guru bhūtaśuddhi prāṇāyāṃma || mātṛkānyāsa || pādādi jānuparyyantaṃ pithivisthānaṃ caturasra pītavarṇai brahmadevataṃ tamadhye la bijaṃ dhyāyat || jānvādi nābhiparyyantaṃ āpasthāṇaṃ dhanuṣākālaṃ || śuklavarṇa viṣṇudaivataṃ tanmadhye ca bījaṃ dhyāyat || nābhyādi hṛdiparjantaṃ tejasthānaṃ tikonākālaṃ
